digest.component_or_area: DC harness rich-text live testing + inbound rich-text echo-suppression + normalize_rich_text contract
propositions: Live DC harness must assert rendered HTML output (via ?expand=renderedFields) for rich-text bodies, verifying that Markdown/wiki markup converts correctly (# → h1, ** → bold, {code} → code macro) when the DC rich-text cutover is enabled.

State-based echo-safety must hold: after pushing a rich-text body and running a reconcile pass, a second pass must compute no inbound description change (inbound=0), proving the landed wire form matches the local body's normalized form.

Concurrent both-sides edits must exhibit local-wins behavior with conflict alerting: when local and remote both diverge from baseline, the reconciler must emit rebar's body and record a deduped outbound-field-conflict alert, preserving the remote value instead of silently clobbering it.

The inbound differ must apply echo-suppression symmetric to the outbound differ: when Jira echoes back the local body's wire form (via map_fields_to_remote), the inbound rich-text description must be recognized as unchanged, preventing spurious inbound updates from lossy codec round-trips.

The normalize_rich_text function must maintain back-compat across the agentic-dev-platform import: signature and behavior of InboundMapper.normalize_rich_text must be pinned by a contract test so breaking changes fail before merge.

The DC rich-text test representative must author code fragments as literal {code} macros (not fenced blocks) so they survive codec normalization and render as <pre> panels on the live instance, proving faithful pass-through of structured wiki markup.
